senses.sense_definition: In een rechte lijn gemeten, zonder omwegen.

examples.text: De afstand tussen de twee steden is <w>hemelsbreed</w> slechts vijftig kilometer.

target_lang_translations.en: The distance between the two cities is only fifty kilometers <w>as the crow flies</w>.

examples.text: Hoewel de weg erg kronkelig is, is de afstand <w>hemelsbreed</w> erg kort.

target_lang_translations.en: Although the road is very winding, the distance <w>as the crow flies</w> is very short.

target_lang_definitions.en: Measured in a straight line, without detours.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: Used to describe the shortest distance between two points in a straight line.
Literal description of distance without following roads or paths.

senses.sense_definition: Zeer groot of opvallend in verschil.

examples.text: Er is een <w>hemelsbreed</w> verschil tussen hun meningen over dit onderwerp.

target_lang_translations.en: There is a <w>vast</w> difference between their opinions on this subject.

examples.text: De twee broers hebben een <w>hemelsbreed</w> verschillende kijk op het leven.

target_lang_translations.en: The two brothers have a <w>vastly</w> different outlook on life.

target_lang_definitions.en: Very large or striking in difference.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: Used to describe a very significant or wide difference.
Used to emphasize the scale of a difference.
